title: Places I've visited
content: Hi everyone! I'm new to the sub. I found it because I looked up why recurring dreams happen. I've been lurking for a few days now and a lot of this stuff seems soooo familiar. I've had several dreams where I visit the same place. It looks to be a city underground with several shops. Kinda like a downtown area so the shops are in walking distance. There's like a train track that goes in front of the shops. I've walked across it to get to the shop. The whole area is usually empty but the shops are open. There is one in particular that I visit every time that has this pastry that I really like. They've been out the last few times I went and people have been visiting so it's not as empty. There's always an eery feeling. I was wondering if anyone else has been here or if this is mall world related? Another place I often visit is a house. Rather, a mansion or hotel. It's historic and beautiful but I can never see the outside. I can tell it's sunny outside as light streams in. I am usually wandering the halls and have found a hidden room that seems stuck in time as the rest of the place seems somewhat renovated. This room is a bedroom. I once left the hallway through a door that led to stairs to what must have been a lobby? I heard voices but quickly went back inside and closed the door to the stairs. I've been here a few times now. Is this a common place? I've also been to an arcade/movie theater/bowling alley. Also empty. Black floor with the colorful designs. Big long hallway. Idk if this is mall world related. They all seem to have a liminal feeling. Curious to know if anyone else has experienced these places?
